company.name: Bend
company.shortDescription: Bend improves spending data accuracy by estimating emissions for precise reporting on scope 3 goods and services.
company.description: Bend is a climate assessment platform intended to make CO2e emissions data programmable and queryable. They provide database of merchant-specific CO2e information, with category fallbacks, and give spend-based CO2e estimates, enabling clients to track companies as they cut carbon and measure their supply chain footprint.

productsAndServices.description: A tool that estimates and tracks carbon emissions from business spending, focusing on scope 3 goods and services emissions for startups and mid-market companies.
productsAndServices.name: Bend Carbon Emissions Tracker and Insights

productsAndServices.description: An API that enriches financial transactions and documents with CO2e emissions estimates and supplier sustainability data for integration into other software systems.
productsAndServices.name: Bend Climate Data API

productsAndServices.description: Consulting and support services for organizations scaling their climate programs, including personalized action plans and supply chain engagement to reduce emissions.
productsAndServices.name: Bend Sustainability Team Services

productsAndServices.description: A free benchmarking tool that provides organizations with a report comparing their emissions against industry benchmarks.
productsAndServices.name: Bend Free Emissions Scorecard

productsAndServices.description: A dashboard for investors to measure and manage the carbon emissions of their investment portfolios, aligned with financial carbon accounting standards.
productsAndServices.name: Bend Portfolio Emissions Dashboard
